steps.title: Choose a Krankenkasse
steps.description: Public health insurance (GKV) is mandatory. Compare funds like TK, AOK, Barmer.

steps.title: Register for insurance
steps.description: Apply online or in person. Coverage starts retroactively from your registration date.

steps.title: Receive Gesundheitskarte
steps.description: Your health card arrives by mail within 2–4 weeks. You are covered immediately upon registration.

steps.title: Find a Hausarzt
steps.description: Register with a general practitioner (Hausarzt) as your primary contact.

options.label: Private (PKV)
cons: Not available for most employees under €69,300/year

warnings: Health insurance is legally mandatory — fines apply for gaps in coverage
